verdict.overall: The biggest change since Sunday is a cluster of sharp rallies (TSLA, PLTR, AMAT, BE and APP all up 5-12%) that pushed several near-term readings from neutral to opposing, meaning resistance is building just above current prices for TSLA, PLTR, BE and ZETA. AVGO, GOOGL, SPY and QQQ look calmer with steadier levels, better suited to range trades, so confidence there is holding up or rising. NVDA has earnings on 11-17 adding risk, and APP looks overbought with opposing readings across all four weeks, so confidence in chasing these two is falling.

tickers.TSLA: Since Sunday: weaker - price jumped 5.5% to 378, pushing right up against this week's 380 ceiling, while the next two weeks flipped from neutral to opposing with magnets near 372-375, pointing to resistance building. Options remain cheap; no earnings in this window.
tickers.PLTR: Since Sunday: weaker nearest-term - price rallied 5.5% to 169, but this week flipped from neutral to opposing with resistance now just above at 170. Later weeks stay neutral with ceilings lifted toward 180-190, leaving room if the bounce continues, though the broader trend is still down.
tickers.NVDA: Since Sunday: little changed in ratings - all four weeks stay neutral, but price dropped 4.3% to 178.67 and magnets slipped down to 195-205, tracking the decline. Earnings land on 11-17, inside this window, and options are pricey, adding risk around that date.
tickers.ZETA: Since Sunday: weaker - price rose 4.5% to 32.42 but the nearest two weeks flipped from neutral to opposing, with resistance widening to 36 this week. Earnings fall today, and options are very pricey, making near-term moves harder to trust.
tickers.AMAT: Since Sunday: price surged 11.4% to 370.55, with floors jumping to 360-370 right under the price, giving firmer near-term support. Earnings land 11-12, just before this week's expiry, adding risk; the furthest week flipped to opposing with resistance pushed out to 425.
tickers.AVGO: Since Sunday: stronger - price climbed 8.8% to 319, and floors rose across all four weeks (up to 300-310), tracking the rally and suggesting firmer support underneath. All weeks remain neutral with cheap options, a fairly calm setup for the month ahead.
tickers.GOOGL: Since Sunday: little changed - price edged up 1.2% to 288 with levels mostly steady, and the furthest week (12-04) improved from neutral to supportive with its magnet sitting right at today's price, a mildly encouraging sign for a range trade.
tickers.APP: Since Sunday: weaker underneath the surface - price rose 4.8% to 410, but all four weeks stay opposing with magnets far below near 290-320, suggesting the options market sees this rally as stretched. RSI near 78 points to overbought conditions.
tickers.BE: Since Sunday: mixed - price jumped 11.9% to 193.88, this week flipped from neutral to opposing with resistance now at 200, but floors for later weeks rose toward 190, showing support catching up with the rally. Options here are pricey across the board.
tickers.SPY: Since Sunday: little changed - price rose 2.4% to 752.69, all four weeks stay neutral with floors and magnets steady near 750-761. In GBP terms (VUSA), this week's magnet is about £105.88, floor £103.05, ceiling £109.55. Trading today is unusually busy near the magnet, so it may shift later.
tickers.QQQ: Since Sunday: little changed - price rose 3.5% to 679, all four weeks remain neutral with magnets drifting slightly lower near 685-700. In GBP terms (ISUS, a rough guide), this week's magnet is about £75.92, floor £73.58, ceiling £76.92.
